_readme: Reference specs for the authored cars (docs/carDesign.md). Each car blends two real donors: their dimensions in mm (sourced; `estimates` lists the keys read off side profiles rather than spec sheets), blend weights, what to take from each, and the lamp signatures. Nothing here is a game dimension: targets are derived as blend(donor value / donor wheelbase) x the car's manifest wheelbase x the `house` multiplier, so the proportions come from the donors and the stylization lives in one place. Readers: scripts/auditCar.ts (npm run audit, headless on the shipped GLB) and scripts/blender/carRefs.py (spec_check in Blender); scripts/blender/carFeatures.py builds the shared features from `house.features`. A calibrated side photo in assets/refs/<carId>/refs.json overrides the estimated keys.

house._scale: Street Scene proportions on top of the blended donors: one 0.28 m wheel for every car, wider (flares) and lower (chopped roof) than real. Measured off the Wendt Strom as shipped. Change here, re-audit every car, and say so: the manifest geometry feeds the sim.

features._: Every number is car space meters at the house scale. Builders in scripts/blender/carFeatures.py read these, so one edit changes every car.

pillars.quarterGlass: hatches only, behind the C pillar

interior._: A donor without a cabin borrows one from a garage car whose donor cabin ships (carFeatures.py interior): never a block. sources: by seating, the car and the fwd station behind its last seat back to crop at; skinMargin: how far inside the skin every cabin vertex must sit.

wendtStrom.brief: Three door hot hatch: the Golf R32 Mk4 donor reduced whole at true size on its own tires, its own lamps (the lens covers recolored from glass), badges, antenna and wipers removed. Front naturally aspirated VR6, all wheel drive biased to the front.

donors.name: 2002 Volkswagen Golf R32 (Mk4)
take: the whole body: reduced to the budget at true size on its own tires
its own lamps: the glass lens covers over the headlights and tail units recolored to lamps

body.roofline: flat roof to a steep tailgate

front.notes: the Golf's own oval covers over twin reflectors, kept from the donor model

rear.notes: the Golf's own corner units, kept from the donor model

kazamaRotor.brief: Two door sports coupe: the RX-7 FD donor reduced whole at true size on its own tires, pop-up headlights modelled raised, its own lamps, badges and lettering removed. Front sequential twin turbo twin rotor, rear wheel drive.

rear.notes: the FD's full width tail bar, kept from the donor model
